# TaskRow

One task in the queue: done check, title, difficulty, estimate and tags, with a highlighted state for the one CLR recommends now.

`CLR.TaskRow` · Tasks

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.TaskRow id="…" title="…" difficulty={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.TaskRow" id="…" title="…" difficulty="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
